subject: Res: Questions on onboarding escrow, HSM seats & residency billing split
messages:
From: Tara Nguyen <tara@medsync.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medsync.com>
Cc: James Lee <james.lee@medsync.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — audit log retention tiers, HSM/KMS options, and billing split

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the demo last week. A few follow-ups from our security and procurement teams: we need a clear pricing pathway for the compliance/security add-ons for an anticipated pilot (3 month) -> production (annual commit) flow. Specifically: 

- Audit logs: pricing for 90/365/1095 day retention tiers, and how ingest vs storage is billed. Do you support tiered S3 classes for long-term archive?
- KMS vs HSM: high-level economics if we use our AWS KMS vs Redwood-managed HSM seats. We are particularly sensitive to attestation and key-rotation SLAs.
- Data residency: we will require US-West residency for PHI (HIPAA). How does residency affect monthly fees and evidence delivery?
- Onboarding escrow/evidence: procurement asked whether some of the implementation + attestation work can be handled as a one-time onboarding escrow (one-time fee) or amortized as recurring credits. They want the cashflow/po timing implications spelled out.

Can you send a concise options matrix and a draft SOW we can attach to a PO? Procurement also asked for DocuSign-ready quote and an estimated lead time to get HSM seats provisioned.

Best,
Tara
Tara Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
MedSync Health

---

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@medsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — audit log retention tiers, HSM/KMS options, and billing split

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass SOW and a pricing workbook (see attachments) — high level options below to make it easier for procurement to compare. I call out pros/cons and PO timing implications for each.

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOW_onboarding_v1.pdf (application/pdf); Pricing_Workbook_MedSync.xlsx (xlsx)

Options summary (pilot -> commit):

1) Managed KMS (Redwood-managed) + standard audit retention
   - Audit logs: ingest pricing per GB + tiered storage (90d / 365d / 1095d). We map long-term retention to colder object classes (costed separately).
   - KMS: Redwood-managed KMS included in monthly recurring (no per-seat). Faster provisioning (~3 business days).
   - Residency: US-West pinned; no surcharge for standard retention up to 365d. Longer retention (>365d) carries a storage add-on.
   - PO timing: recurring charges start on activation; no one-time escrow required.

2) Customer KMS + HSM seats (hybrid)
   - HSM seats: priced per seat/month with a one-time provisioning fee for attestation + HSM key ceremony support. Typical lead time: 10–15 business days for dedicated HSM allocation and attestation.
   - If customer supplies KMS, we add an integration/validation one-time fee (SOW).
   - Residency: same as above but HSM seat add-on applies when keys are held in-customer region.
   - PO timing: HSM seats billed monthly after provisioning; attestation work can be invoiced as a one-time onboarding escrow or amortized across the first 12 months as recurring credits.

3) Residency + evidence heavy path (HIPAA + 3rd party attestation)
   - Includes audit-log export SLA, signed attestation report delivery milestones, and expedited evidence packaging.
   - This path carries an implementation uplift (one-time) and an optional annual evidence maintenance fee.

Suggested commercial levers we can use: pilot credits against implementation, tiered storage discounts at commit levels, and a conditional waiver of the onboarding escrow if you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben / Laura and I will align on an explicit pricing scenario (pilot + 12-month commit) and return a DocuSign quote by EOD Friday.
- Tara / Procurement to confirm preferred retention tier and whether you want Redwood-managed KMS or to bring your own KMS/HSM seats.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to run through the workbook.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cell: (415) 555-0132

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Nguyen <tara@medsync.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — audit log retention tiers, HSM/KMS options, and billing split

Looping in a couple of commercial notes — rough numbers (we'll finalize in the workbook):

- Audit log ingest: $0.02 / GB ingest for pilot, moving to $0.015 / GB at commit >= $50k/month. Storage: $0.004 / GB-month for 90d, $0.0025 / GB-month for 365d, archive tier $0.0009 / GB-month for 1095d (cold).
- HSM seat: $1,200 / seat-month; provisioning fee $12,000 (covers attestation & key ceremony).
- Integration/validation (customer KMS): one-time $6,000 (3–5 business days).
- Onboarding escrow: we can structure $30k as a one-time escrow for attestation & evidence delivery OR amortize as $2,500/month credit over first 12 months; if MedSync commits to 12-month reserved capacity >= $60k/mo we waive 50% of the escrow.

Commercial flexibility we recommend including in the quote:
- Pilot credit: $10k credit applied to first invoice on conversion to commit.
- Storage discount ladder: 10% at $75k ARR, 18% at $200k ARR.

Laura — can you confirm the minimal evidence delivery SLA and whether we can map the proof milestone to delivery of the attestation package (so procurement can sign off)?

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---

From: Tara Nguyen <tara@medsync.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — audit log retention tiers, HSM/KMS options, and billing split

Chloe / Ben / Laura — this is helpful, thanks. Procurement is leaning to: customer KMS + 2 HSM seats for the pilot (we'll scale seats with usage), 365d retention for production, and Redwood to prepare SOW + DocuSign-ready quote with the two commercial options: (A) $30k onboarding escrow one-time, (B) amortize the escrow as recurring credits with the 12-month commit discount applied.

A couple of quick clarifications before we finalize:
- Confirm the 10–15 business day provisioning lead time for HSM seats in US-West.
- Please show the bridge math in the workbook so procurement can see pilot -> commit monthly cashflow and the net cash impact of amortizing escrow.
- Procurement contact for PO routing is procurement@medsync.com — they will need an invoice template attached.

If you can get the DocuSign packet and invoice template over by close of business tomorrow, we'll route internally and aim to sign the SOW next week.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
MedSync Health
